trigger: explicit native household/dirty-dish observation, never a desktop/global poll

NATIVE_DRAG_EQUIVALENT.purpose: Cursor-free EA-native operation proven to reproduce actual player-drag disposal reward.
NATIVE_DRAG_EQUIVALENT.payout_assumption: Never assert as actual earnings until independent in-game before/after evidence.

NATIVE_SIM_DISPOSE.purpose: Ordinary native Sim trash disposal, not assumed to reproduce player-drag payout.

choice_policy: Prefer confirmed drag-equivalent mechanic; use ordinary native Sim disposal as explicit lower-payout fallback only when observed and enabled; never inject simoleons or modify savings directly.
route_proof: Exact patch native interaction ID and reward mechanics must be independently inspected, not inferred from a community guide or user screenshot.
outcome: Only independent attributed before/after household-funds evidence plus actual dish removal verifies earnings; after DISPATCHED, hold until reconciled; no retries on stale snapshots.

cleanup_queue_redirection.native_action_identity: Exact installed-build native queue slot, action ID, actor, item, origin proof, native source ref and destination ref must agree with currently observed queue entry
cleanup_queue_redirection.spatial_admission: An externally attested current-home lot, exact game build, capture, named item and NanoCan objects, world revision, explicit floor relation and actual native route reachability are required before a paired queue-redirection proposal
cleanup_queue_redirection.game_native_preference: Inspect EA tuning first; use EA embedded script only if source proven. An atomic replace-or-preserve-original transaction is required. No UI queue cancellation.
cleanup_queue_redirection.destination_priority: Replace only exact competing verified cleanup slot for same observed item, never unrelated queue or whim icons
cleanup_queue_redirection.world_revision_binding: spatial_proof.world_revision_ref must match a separately observed current lot world_revision_ref for the exact capture, build and lot; a remembered map cannot attest itself
cleanup_queue_redirection.player_item_reservation: Any player-or-unknown household queue entry claiming the exact waste/dish item protects it from even actorless advice
cleanup_queue_redirection.choice_order: Prefer exact proven atomic queue-replace candidate, then route payout priority and stable item/can ID; never cancel before replacement
cleanup_queue_redirection.queue_phase: Only confirmed QUEUED phase may be advised for replacement; ACTIVE/UNKNOWN are observed but not intervention candidates
cleanup_queue_redirection.queue_revision: Require identical current observed revision, pending cleanup revision and exact queue slot revision
cleanup_queue_redirection.queued_native_provenance: game_build, source_kind, destination_kind, action_kind_verified and capture must agree across source-classification and actual queue row
cleanup_queue_redirection.legacy_sink_compatibility: sink_suppression_candidate is an alias only when same evidence-proven source SIM_AUTONOMY sink queue is an eligible atomic queue redirection; pending_sink alone no longer qualifies
cleanup_queue_redirection.unresolved_player_target: Player/unknown queued action without an independently identified item_ref protects every possible item; missing/stale actor queue snapshot denies even actorless proposals

waste_items.object_policy: Verified truly disposable waste only; unknown, edible, valuable, personal or reserved objects are not eligible. Native item tags and exact interaction compatibility required.
waste_items.payout: Unknown until exact native game observation; do not reuse dish estimate.
waste_items.outcome: one independently observed disappearance and causal funds evidence per item; no automatic payout
